name: Composio Mcp
description:
Composio helps Claude find the right tools, connect to your apps as needed, and automate work across them. Read and update data, trigger actions, and run multi-step workflows across email, CRMs, ticketing systems, databases, and more — Gmail, Notion, Slack, Linear, GitHub, Google Calendar, and 1000+ others.

Use it to triage inboxes, create issues, sync records between apps, and handle repetitive operational tasks from a single Claude Code conversation. Composio finds the right tool from the catalog, opens an OAuth window the first time each app is connected, and runs the action under your own credentials — no API keys in your config.

The plugin bundles the Composio Connect MCP server with three opinionated skills:

- composio-mcp: how to use the meta-tools (search → connect → execute) and the recommended dispatcher flow.
- onboarding: interactive setup that asks what you want to automate, recommends 2–4 apps, and walks you through connecting them.
- company-activity-summary: cross-app activity rollup across Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear, Gmail, and more.
longDescription:
Ships **3 skills**.

- **Skills** (3): `company-activity-summary` (Generates comprehensive company activity summary across connected apps — Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear, Gmail, and more), `composio-cli` (Help users operate the Composio CLI to find tools, connect accounts, inspect schemas, execute tools, subscribe to trigger…), `composio-onboarding` (Interactive onboarding — checks CLI install and auth, learns what the user wants to automate across their apps,…)

Installs with `claude plugin install composio-mcp@claude-community` from `ComposioHQ/composio-plugin-cc` (`plugins/composio-cli`).
